title: Gungriffon II (Demo)
overview:
Loaded with new features such as the long-awaited Replay Mode, VS Mode and Co-op Mode, the champion of 3D shooting finally launches!!

World War III rages between the Asia Pacific Community and the Pan European Union. Strap into the cockpit of a bipedal armored walker with the APC forces and fight through a series of missions - striking supply convoys, rescuing stranded engineers and covering retreating allies against tanks, attack helicopters and enemy walkers.

Gungriffon II is a 3D mech shooter played from the cockpit. Connect two Saturns with the link cable for multiplayer battles.

This disc is a demo version of the game.

- 1-4 players
- Replay, VS and Co-op modes
- Link cable and Twin Stick support

待望のリプレイモード、VSモード、協力モードなどの、新機能を満載し、3Dシューティングの雄がついに発進!!
